messages:
naveen: Found a Vault token inside an old GCE VM snapshot while cleaning up stale disks. Path: /opt/backup/creds.tar.gz -> vault-token.txt. Snapshot created 2024-11-02. Token looks like a long-lived service token (policy=ci-runner). Need rotation/cleanup plan.

olivia: ack. Which project/env is this? staging or prod?

naveen: staging only (project=redwood-staging). Instance snapshot name: ci-runner-02-snap-20241102. Token value redacted here. Did a quick `vault token-lookup` by accessor; saw last_used 2025-02-15 and TTL seems > 0.

jessica: Priority: high but contained. Proposed steps: 1) Canary revoke token, 2) Global revoke if canary ok, 3) Scan buckets/images for copies, 4) Rotate any related GCP service account keys / rewrap KMS ciphertexts if token was used to wrap backups, 5) Tighten RBAC/token TTLs.

devops-oncall: I can own the revoke. Need confirmation that current CI runners won't be impacted (they should use ephemeral tokens).

naveen: CI runners were migrated to ephemeral tokens months ago; this token appears unused but active. I'll do a quick grep across running job envs to be sure.

security-rotations-bot: Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/sec/runbooks/token-leak (refer to section "VM snapshot creds"). Also recommends rewrapping transit keys if backups are affected.

olivia: Can someone paste the exact commands you'll run for revoke + verification?

jessica: Use these as checklist:
```
vault token-revoke -force <token_value>
# OR revoke by accessor
vault token-revoke -accessor <accessor_id>
# verify
vault token-lookup -accessor <accessor_id>  # expect 403 or not_found
# list accessors
vault list auth/token/accessors
```
For GCP KMS rewrap: re-encrypt blobs with new key version via a batch job (gcloud kms keys versions create/disable + re-encrypt). Coordinate with backup owners.

devops-oncall: Scheduling a 30m maintenance window 16:00 UTC today to run canary then global revoke. Will post progress.

naveen: Canary: revoked accessor in canary namespace at 16:03 UTC. No errors in canary CI. Monitoring for 15m.

olivia: After revoke, search storage/logs for token string. I can run a regex scan across GCS buckets and partner logs. Will post results.

jessica: Also escalate to infra to rewrap any Vault-encrypted backup if the token could have been used for unwrapping. See transit key rotation section in runbook.

security-rotations-bot: Created rotation ticket ROT-7890 and assigned to devops-oncall + jessica. Compliance evidence checklist added.

devops-oncall: Canary looks clean. Proceeding with global revoke at 16:17 UTC. Executed `vault token-revoke -accessor <redacted>` and confirmed `vault token-lookup` now returns not_found.

naveen: Verified audit logs: last usage was 2025-02-15, no new activity after revoke. No CI failures observed.

olivia: Found two additional image snapshots containing similar creds (same timeframe). I'll schedule an image-sweep to delete or re-snapshot them without creds.

jessica: Next actions:
- Image sweep + scrub snapshots (owner: olivia)
- KMS rewrap job for backup blobs (owner: naveen, coordinate with infra)
- RBAC policy change: enforce max TTL 30m for CI tokens (owner: jessica)
- Post-incident scan across all projects for tokens in images (automation ticket).

security-rotations-bot: ETA for completion set to 2 hours. Marking ROT-7890 as in_progress.

devops-oncall: KMS rewrap kickoff started at 17:05 UTC. Re-encrypting backup blobs to new key version. Will post success/failure per-batch.

naveen: KMS rewrap completed for first batch, no errors. Will continue overnight for older archives.

olivia: RBAC patch submitted (PR 4821) to enforce token TTL limit and deny creation of non-ephemeral tokens for ci-runner role. Please review.

jessica: Reviewed and approved. We'll roll policy at 02:00 UTC maintenance to minimize disruption.

security-rotations-bot: Rotation evidence uploaded to compliance bucket: gs://compliance-evidence/rot-7890/*. Please attach PRs and logs.

naveen: Closing note: This was a stale snapshot-leak, not an active compromise. Still doing full sweep to be safe. Planning a short blameless postmortem doc with remediation items and deadlines.

devops-oncall: Global job finished at 19:12 UTC. All ticket checkboxes passed. Closing ROT-7890 once postmortem is in. :white_check_mark:
summary: Coordination thread for finding a Vault token in a staging VM snapshot, canary revoke, global revoke, image sweep, KMS rewrap, RBAC tightening, and tickets/runbook references.
